notes.title: Remix Level Fixes! (Patch v1.0.9)
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p][/p][p]Funny story but.. I think last patch introduced some issues in the Remix / Challenge levels at the end of the game. If you want the inside scoop, some of the optimization for the Nintendo Switch version got through and wasn't fully stable on the Steam version so it threw some errors which caused some players to not being able to finish those levels.[/p][p][/p][p]That should be fixed now and in general work better (fingers crossed).[/p][p][/p][p][b]IN OTHER NEWS, my company WhyKev turns 6 years old[/b] on the 27th of September. There's always room in the comment section if you want to say congrats down below![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42502259/e1ad9810245a1aadeaa332ab6580ea4d49fcb8c5.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Now.. back to porting this game, I appreciate that some of you have kept asking for console versions![/p][p][/p][p]Take care,[/p][p]Kevin[/p]

notes.title: New Artwork! (Patch v1.0.8)
notes.content: [p]Hello Egg Collectors![/p][p][/p][p]I hope your summer break have been great! I've managed to find time to update some smaller issues and continued the port for the Nintendo Switch version (are we allowed to talk about that stuff here?).[/p][p][/p][p]Either way, for the upcoming console release and future of PaperKlay I wanted to make sure the artwork reflected the tone of the game (for context, the previous artwork was made after working on the game for 5 months, and the full release took almost 3.5 years so the game changed in tone a bit in that time).[/p][p][/p][p]Patch Notes:[/p][list][*][p]Floor is lava puzzle should now be more stable when on low framerate.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed small visual issue in last Nugget level.[/p][/*][*][p]Cogs on the side of the screen in pause menu are now hidden when not able to be used to avoid confusion.[/p][/*][*][p]Secret door in Wool Tower now have collision... forcing you to actually solve the secret.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed a platform sequence in the third remix level, this [b]should[/b] improve framerate.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where the black shadow below player would sometimes get stuck when jump off a ledge.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]This is the "full artwork" but I'll mostly use a version with less characters to make it more readable![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42502259/d3401e424ac2650e17930ef6a68715e538a5528c.png"][/img][/p][p]Take care everyone[/p][p]/Kevin[/p]

notes.title: Camera Improvements (Patch v1.0.4)
notes.content:
Hello again everyone!

[b]TLDR; Camera now behaves more as expected when it comes too close to a wall.[/b]

Sorry for these intense patches rolling in so frequently. In a perfect world I'd like to make one big and then breathe out but I think it's important to focus on one thing and get that live. There are new people playing all the time and if one small thing stop them from having a bad time due to technical issues then it's worth it to have these smaller patches.

But with this one I think "the worst is over". Since release I have increased the movement speed, added a sprint, fixed the wall clipping with the player and now improved how the camera acts as well. Sometimes it would also go through the wall. I'm sure in time I'll tweak some small things but players should have a better experience overall.

Patch Notes
[list]
[*] Camera avoiding walls is now improved
[*] Collision fixes in Snow Remix level
[*] About 6 buttons would spin with the top layer of a rotation object in the Remix level, rotating that would move them out of bounds. This is now fixed <3
[*] Fixed a typo with Mr.Chillington dialog.
[/list]

I have some smaller things on my list that I've found while watching people play. Nothing that majority of people notice (I hope) but I might take a breather for a few days before patching again (fingers crossed I'm not jinxing this).

- Kevin

notes.title: Collision Improvements (Patch v1.0.3)
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

I'm so glad to hear that many of you appreciate the patch yesterday that improved speed and added a sprint. So far nothing seems to be broken with this increased speed (fingers crossed).

Some of you have noticed that you could clip through walls, I believe I have a fix for that. I personally couldn't recreate it on my PC or my Steam Deck. I don't have the confidence to say that it's perfect now, but I do believe that a casual player wouldn't find in a normal playthrough.

[b]Patch Notes[/b]
[list]
[*] Wall detection should be improved to prevent player clipping through walls.
[*] Improved and fixed bugs in the pause menu when using a keyboard
[*] Small fix for rotating platforms in Goldfish Hills that slipped through in last patch
[/list]

Again, thank you so much for your patience and civilized tone in the communication. I appreciate it a lot!

- Kevin

notes.title: Added sprint and faster movement!
notes.content:
[b]Important Update[/b]

I hear you, some of you feel that Chick is moving too slow. Even though there are ways to move faster than normal running I'd still want to find a balance that works for the majority of players and not breaks the game. [b]I've increased the running speed and added a sprint feature.[/b] It's the same one as you pick up stuff with, will only work when you're not carrying anything and are on the ground.

I appreciate you guys being patient with me as I update the game. PaperKlay is very special to me and the last thing I want is for players to have a negative experience because of technical issues.

[b]Patch Notes[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased movement speed + added a sprint functionality
[*] Fixed some collision issues across the game (mostly missing in some areas)
[*] Vibration now properly adjusts based on your settings
[*] Added delay before the confirmation button can be pressed when deleting a save file
[*] Some sounds weren't adjusting its volume based on your settings
[/list]

Aside from this I also made a new devlog talking about the last time before the game came out. If you want to watch that then here it is!
[previewyoutube=vJb_xfocXnU;full][/previewyoutube]

- Kevin

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

Here comes the first proper patch after the release of the game.
I've really enjoyed seeing you guys have fun and sharing stories how you stayed up late to finish the game or how you've played with your kids. It really makes this whole thing feel special!

Here's a list of the things I've fixed.
[b]Patch 1.0.1[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased throw force when not tossing towards a target
[*] Coins from boxes now fly to you after a short while, will prevent some rare issues with coins ending up inside walls.
[*] Nugget ground check improved, a rare scenario where nugget could fall between the smallest gap between platforms.
[*] Dying after defeating the boss in Goldfish Hills would result in boss restarting without the boss.
[*] Fixed a small typo in the last level.
[*] Walking to the back of the skull face in Skull Island level will no longer unload the inside of the skull.
[*] Small text issues when using Japanese or Chinese language are now resolved.
[*] Improved performance on some levels that had very small fps drops.
[/list]

I appreciate the feedback I've been getting and how supporting everyone has been. 

Thank you so much :)

- Kevin
